notes.author: claude-fable-triage
notes.text: TRIAGED (source review 2026-08-09, confidence high): No auto-follow exists in MSUI at any layer: no follow movement mode, no /follow or FollowUnit entry point, no AUTOFOLLOW_BEGIN/AUTOFOLLOW_END transitions, and no AutoFollowStatus 'Following %s.' / 'You stop following %s.' fading status line.

notes.author: claude-fable-triage
notes.text: TRIAGE FINDING: Benilla's module is only the UI bridge over its player-side follow mode; MSUI lacks both halves, so this is one missing feature, not two.
